# Renewable Energy Cost Revolution: LCOE, Capacity & Fossil Fuel Subsidies (2010–2024)

## Overview
This collection of four datasets tracks the economic transformation of the global energy sector from 2010 to 2024. It covers the declining levelized cost of energy for solar PV, onshore wind, and battery storage; the cost range of new fossil fuel generation; cumulative renewable installed capacity; and annual global fossil fuel subsidies.

## Data Source

### lcoe_trends
Annual LCOE values for three technologies: `solar_pv`, `onshore_wind`, and `battery_storage`. All values in 2023 real USD per MWh. 15 rows (2010–2024). Solar PV ranges from 359 to 33; onshore wind from 95 to 35; battery storage from 1,100 to 102.

### fossil_fuel_lcoe_range
Biennial LCOE ranges for new-build gas CCGT (`gas_ccgt_low`, `gas_ccgt_high`) and coal (`coal_low`, `coal_high`). 8 rows at even-year intervals. Values in 2023 real USD/MWh. These define the reference band against which renewable crossover points are identified.

### installed_capacity
Cumulative global installed capacity in GW for `solar_pv_gw` and `onshore_wind_gw`. 15 rows (2010–2024). Solar PV grows from 40 to 1,950 GW; onshore wind from 178 to 960 GW.

### fossil_fuel_subsidies
Annual global fossil fuel subsidies in nominal billion USD, split into `consumption_subsidies_bn` and `production_subsidies_bn`, with a `total_subsidies_bn` sum. 15 rows (2010–2024). Total ranges from ~290 to ~700 billion.

## Data Notes
- LCOE figures are illustrative estimates aligned with IRENA and BloombergNEF reporting trends but rounded for clarity.
- Battery storage LCOE reflects 4-hour lithium-ion systems.
- 2022 spike in fossil LCOE and subsidies reflects the global energy price crisis.
- Fossil fuel subsidy estimates cover direct government subsidies only; implicit subsidies (e.g., unpriced externalities) are excluded.
- 2024 values are preliminary estimates.

This collection of four datasets tracks the economic transformation of the global energy sector from 2010 to 2024. It covers the declining levelized cost of energy for solar PV, onshore wind, and battery storage; the cost range of new fossil fuel generation; cumulative renewable installed capacity; and annual global fossil fuel subsidies.

### lcoe_trends
Annual LCOE values for three technologies: `solar_pv`, `onshore_wind`, and `battery_storage`. All values in 2023 real USD per MWh. 15 rows (2010–2024). Solar PV ranges from 359 to 33; onshore wind from 95 to 35; battery storage from 1,100 to 102.

import json
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.gridspec import GridSpec

# Load data
with open("/app/benchmark/source_data.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

lcoe = data["lcoe_trends"]["data"]
fossil = data["fossil_fuel_lcoe_range"]["data"]
capacity = data["installed_capacity"]["data"]
subsidies = data["fossil_fuel_subsidies"]["data"]

# Extract arrays
years_lcoe = [d["year"] for d in lcoe]
solar_pv = [d["solar_pv"] for d in lcoe]
onshore_wind = [d["onshore_wind"] for d in lcoe]
battery_storage = [d["battery_storage"] for d in lcoe]

years_fossil = [d["year"] for d in fossil]
gas_low = [d["gas_ccgt_low"] for d in fossil]
gas_high = [d["gas_ccgt_high"] for d in fossil]
coal_low = [d["coal_low"] for d in fossil]
coal_high = [d["coal_high"] for d in fossil]

years_cap = [d["year"] for d in capacity]
solar_gw = [d["solar_pv_gw"] for d in capacity]
wind_gw = [d["onshore_wind_gw"] for d in capacity]

years_sub = [d["year"] for d in subsidies]
consumption_sub = [d["consumption_subsidies_bn"] for d in subsidies]
production_sub = [d["production_subsidies_bn"] for d in subsidies]
total_sub = [d["total_subsidies_bn"] for d in subsidies]

# ── Color palette (editorial, publication-ready) ──
C_SOLAR = "#D4A017"       # Deep gold
C_WIND = "#2E8B7A"        # Teal
C_BATTERY = "#C44E2B"     # Warm red/coral
C_GAS_BAND = "#B0B0B0"    # Gray for gas range
C_COAL_BAND = "#808080"   # Darker gray for coal range
C_CONSUMPTION = "#5C4033" # Dark brown
C_PRODUCTION = "#A0785A"  # Light brown
C_BG = "#FAFAF8"          # Off-white background
C_GRID = "#E0DED8"        # Subtle grid
C_TEXT = "#2C2C2C"        # Near-black text
C_ANNOTATION = "#444444"

# ── Figure setup ──
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 16), facecolor=C_BG)
gs = GridSpec(3, 1, height_ratios=[3, 1.5, 1.2], hspace=0.32,
              left=0.10, right=0.92, top=0.93, bottom=0.05)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 1: LCOE TRENDS + FOSSIL FUEL RANGE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0])
ax1.set_facecolor(C_BG)

# Fossil fuel LCOE bands
ax1.fill_between(years_fossil, gas_low, gas_high, alpha=0.18, color=C_GAS_BAND,
                 edgecolor=C_GAS_BAND, linewidth=0.5, zorder=1)
ax1.fill_between(years_fossil, coal_low, coal_high, alpha=0.15, color=C_COAL_BAND,
                 edgecolor=C_COAL_BAND, linewidth=0.5, zorder=1)

# Fossil fuel band edge lines
ax1.plot(years_fossil, gas_low, color=C_GAS_BAND, linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6, zorder=2)
ax1.plot(years_fossil, gas_high, color=C_GAS_BAND, linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6, zorder=2)
ax1.plot(years_fossil, coal_low, color=C_COAL_BAND, linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6, zorder=2)
ax1.plot(years_fossil, coal_high, color=C_COAL_BAND, linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6, zorder=2)

# Battery storage (plot first since it's highest, but use secondary y-axis concept via clipping)
# We'll use a broken/inset approach for battery — or just let it go high
# Actually battery goes up to 1100 which compresses the other lines too much.
# Solution: clip y-axis and annotate battery separately, or use log scale.
# Best editorial choice: log scale for LCOE to show all trajectories clearly.

ax1.set_yscale('log')

# Renewable LCOE lines
ax1.plot(years_lcoe, battery_storage, color=C_BATTERY, linewidth=2.5, zorder=5,
         marker='o', markersize=4, label='Battery Storage')
ax1.plot(years_lcoe, solar_pv, color=C_SOLAR, linewidth=2.8, zorder=6,
         marker='s', markersize=4, label='Solar PV')
ax1.plot(years_lcoe, onshore_wind, color=C_WIND, linewidth=2.8, zorder=6,
         marker='^', markersize=4, label='Onshore Wind')

# ── Crossover annotations ──
# Solar PV crosses below gas CCGT low (~42-55 range) around 2016-2017
# Onshore Wind crosses below gas CCGT low around 2016-2017
# Solar PV crosses below coal low around 2019-2020

# Find crossover years (solar < gas_ccgt_high)
# Gas CCGT high in 2016 = 72, solar in 2016 = 86, solar in 2017 = 72 -> crosses at 2017
# Wind crosses gas high (72) in 2016 (wind=56)

# Solar crosses below coal low (60-65) around 2018 (solar=60)
# Wind crosses below coal low around 2018 (wind=48)

# Annotate solar crossover with gas
ax1.annotate('Solar PV falls below\nnew gas CCGT range',
             xy=(2017, 72), xytext=(2019.5, 140),
             fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=C_SOLAR,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_SOLAR, lw=1.2),
             ha='center', va='bottom', zorder=10)

# Annotate wind crossover with gas
ax1.annotate('Wind undercuts\nnew gas CCGT',
             xy=(2016, 56), xytext=(2013, 38),
             fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=C_WIND,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_WIND, lw=1.2),
             ha='center', va='bottom', zorder=10)

# Annotate solar/wind crossover with coal
ax1.annotate('Both solar & wind cheaper\nthan new coal plants',
             xy=(2019, 47), xytext=(2022, 25),
             fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=C_ANNOTATION,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_ANNOTATION, lw=1.2),
             ha='center', va='top', zorder=10)

# Battery annotation
ax1.annotate('Battery storage:\n$1,100 → $102/MWh\n(91% decline)',
             xy=(2010, 1100), xytext=(2012.5, 700),
             fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=C_BATTERY,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_BATTERY, lw=1.2),
             ha='center', va='center', zorder=10)

# Fossil fuel band labels
ax1.text(2024.3, 65, 'Gas CCGT\nrange', fontsize=7, color='#888888',
         va='center', ha='left', style='italic')
ax1.text(2024.3, 95, 'Coal\nrange', fontsize=7, color='#777777',
         va='center', ha='left', style='italic')

ax1.set_xlim(2009.5, 2025.5)
ax1.set_ylim(20, 1300)
ax1.set_ylabel('Levelized Cost of Energy (USD/MWh, 2023 real)', fontsize=10, color=C_TEXT)
ax1.set_title('Renewable Energy Cost Revolution: LCOE Decline & Fossil Fuel Crossover (2010–2024)',
              fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=C_TEXT, pad=12)
ax1.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=9, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor=C_GRID)
ax1.grid(True, which='major', color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
ax1.grid(True, which='minor', color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.3, alpha=0.4)
ax1.tick_params(colors=C_TEXT, labelsize=9)

# Custom log y-ticks
ax1.set_yticks([20, 30, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000])
ax1.get_yaxis().set_major_formatter(plt.ScalarFormatter())
ax1.set_yticklabels(['$20', '$30', '$50', '$100', '$200', '$500', '$1,000'])

# Panel label
ax1.text(0.01, 0.97, 'A', transform=ax1.transAxes, fontsize=14, fontweight='bold',
         va='top', ha='left', color=C_TEXT)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 2: INSTALLED CAPACITY
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1])
ax2.set_facecolor(C_BG)

ax2.fill_between(years_cap, solar_gw, alpha=0.2, color=C_SOLAR, zorder=2)
ax2.fill_between(years_cap, wind_gw, alpha=0.15, color=C_WIND, zorder=2)
ax2.plot(years_cap, solar_gw, color=C_SOLAR, linewidth=2.8, zorder=5,
         marker='s', markersize=4, label='Solar PV')
ax2.plot(years_cap, wind_gw, color=C_WIND, linewidth=2.8, zorder=5,
         marker='^', markersize=4, label='Onshore Wind')

# Annotate acceleration
ax2.annotate('Solar PV acceleration:\n40 GW → 1,950 GW\n(49× growth)',
             xy=(2024, 1950), xytext=(2019, 1600),
             fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=C_SOLAR,
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_SOLAR, lw=1.2),
             ha='center', va='center', zorder=10)

# Highlight steep post-2018 section
ax2.axvspan(2018, 2024, alpha=0.06, color=C_SOLAR, zorder=0)
ax2.text(2021, 80, 'Post-2018\nacceleration', fontsize=7.5, color=C_SOLAR,
         ha='center', va='bottom', style='italic', alpha=0.8)

ax2.set_xlim(2009.5, 2025.5)
ax2.set_ylabel('Cumulative Capacity (GW)', fontsize=10, color=C_TEXT)
ax2.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor=C_GRID)
ax2.grid(True, color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
ax2.tick_params(colors=C_TEXT, labelsize=9)

# Panel label
ax2.text(0.01, 0.97, 'B', transform=ax2.transAxes, fontsize=14, fontweight='bold',
         va='top', ha='left', color=C_TEXT)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 3: FOSSIL FUEL SUBSIDIES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2])
ax3.set_facecolor(C_BG)

# Stacked bars
bar_width = 0.7
bars_consumption = ax3.bar(years_sub, consumption_sub, bar_width,
                           color=C_CONSUMPTION, label='Consumption subsidies', zorder=3)
bars_production = ax3.bar(years_sub, production_sub, bar_width,
                          bottom=consumption_sub, color=C_PRODUCTION,
                          label='Production subsidies', zorder=3)

# Total line
ax3.plot(years_sub, total_sub, color='#8B0000', linewidth=2, zorder=5,
         marker='o', markersize=3, label='Total subsidies')

# Annotate 2022 spike
ax3.annotate('2022 energy crisis\npeak: $700B',
             xy=(2022, 700), xytext=(2020, 680),
             fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color='#8B0000',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#8B0000', lw=1.2),
             ha='center', va='center', zorder=10)

# Add subsidy total labels for key years
for yr, val in [(2010, 410), (2015, 325), (2020, 290), (2022, 700), (2024, 550)]:
    ax3.text(yr, val + 15, f'${val}B', fontsize=7, ha='center', va='bottom',
             color='#8B0000', fontweight='bold')

# Average subsidy line
avg_sub = np.mean(total_sub)
ax3.axhline(y=avg_sub, color='#8B0000', linewidth=1, linestyle=':', alpha=0.5, zorder=2)
ax3.text(2025.5, avg_sub, f'Avg\n${avg_sub:.0f}B', fontsize=7, color='#8B0000',
         va='center', ha='left', alpha=0.7)

ax3.set_xlim(2009.5, 2025.5)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 800)
ax3.set_ylabel('Subsidies (Billion USD)', fontsize=10, color=C_TEXT)
ax3.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=10, color=C_TEXT)
ax3.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=8.5, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor=C_GRID, ncol=3)
ax3.grid(True, axis='y', color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
ax3.tick_params(colors=C_TEXT, labelsize=9)
ax3.set_xticks(range(2010, 2025, 2))

# Panel label
ax3.text(0.01, 0.97, 'C', transform=ax3.transAxes, fontsize=14, fontweight='bold',
         va='top', ha='left', color=C_TEXT)

# ── Overall footer ──
fig.text(0.5, 0.01,
         'Sources: IRENA, BloombergNEF (illustrative estimates aligned with reported trends)  |  '
         'LCOE in 2023 real USD/MWh  |  Subsidies in nominal USD  |  2024 values are preliminary',
         fontsize=7, ha='center', va='bottom', color='#888888', style='italic')

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=200, bbox_inches='tight',

plt.close()

# Average subsidy line
